title: View Model Neo
description: This mod allows you to adjust the position, the rotation and the size of the hands and items.
body:
This mod allows you to adjust the position, the rotation and the size of the hands and items.
To change the size of the hand, set the _Z_ coordinate to a negative value, then reposition it where you want it using the _Y_ and _X_ coordinates.

You can edit these values in the configuration folder (via TOML file) or in the in-game GUI.
You can open the GUI with **V** key by default, you can change this keybind.

If you'd like to give suggestions or report bugs, join my Discord server:
https://discord.gg/vYkxsaeWMf
